messages.message: Add STATE_ADEQUACY_STABILITY before promotion. Conditioning-depth instability yields ABSTAIN_STATE_INADEQUATE; stability survives one falsifier only and is not causal proof.
Persist per-depth candidate lag, conditioning set, estimator, effective samples, calibration, edge set and instability statistic. Preserve adaptive-parent comparator eligibility.
Register H-UDB-EM-014 and H-UDB-EM-015 with the full counterhypotheses. Method support count is auditable diagnostic evidence, never a truth vote.
For temporal causal-use claims, replay fixed candidate lags across increasing observed-history closures and registered contexts; do not change the tested edge while calling it a depth comparison.
Receiver-use effects must remain stable to adequate history/context conditioning; apparent re-entry value that vanishes with state closure is not promoted.
Store graph deltas across matched conditioning depths. Instability flags state inadequacy and cannot itself identify a latent cause or authorize a replacement edge.
